basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Founding Engineer & Agentic AI Builder | Production Systems for Investors (PulseView) | 3× Founder | MBA
basics.summary: Agency, ownership, and production scars. I built and run the LumApps multi-agent outbound system in production (Python on GCP Vertex AI, tools over MCP I authored, evals + on-call), and I was there every time it broke. Founding engineer at Dronistics before that (empty repo to 500+ deliveries), and 3 AI products founded solo through Anand Creations. Deep investment-domain relevance: PulseView (my AI market intelligence product, live users), Tenity mentor evaluating 20+ startups per year for seed-to-VC decisions. Open source that people actually use (Terraform module, ~4,600 users). Zurich-based, Switzerland-native, ready to own the first technical seat.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and shipped a production multi-agent system that real users (Sales, RevOps) depend on daily. Python on GCP Vertex AI, LangGraph + Google ADK, tools over MCP servers I authored, agent state streamed over AG-UI. I was on-call every time it broke and own the postmortems. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly.

Own the evaluation and quality harness: golden suites, judge rubrics, safety cases per agent, LangSmith tracing so every run reconstructs from its log. Rigorous on anything a user touches; fast and rough on experiments.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one auditable context store. Closed the architecture decision solo; report to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Ran observability and global on-call across production systems used by 10M+ users (K8s, AWS, Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io). Was there when it broke; provisioned, deployed, rolled back systems end to end.
Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). Concept to production, no gatekeepers.
Architected Employee Referral System end to end. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR.
Read, debugged, and improved codebases I did not write across 3 teams. Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Technology Evaluation Panelist for a VC / seed accelerator. Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production; advised multiple portfolio companies on AI strategy.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Shipped full stack from empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform infra).
Closed every architecture decision solo. Built partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.
